items.title: Come si distinguono
items.html:
Past simple — un'azione finita, conclusa.
Spie: yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago, on Sunday.
Forma: played (regolari) oppure la seconda colonna dei verbi irregolari (went, saw, took).

Past continuous — un'azione in corso in quel momento.
Spie: while, at five o'clock, all day.
Forma: was / were + verbo-ing

Insieme: l'azione lunga va al continuous, quella che la interrompe al simple.
I was reading when he arrived.

items.prompt: I ___ to the stadium on Sunday.
items.why: on Sunday, azione conclusa → past simple. Il passato di go è went.

items.prompt: While I ___ TV, the phone rang.
items.why: while introduce l'azione lunga → past continuous: was watching.
Azione conclusa, yesterday → past simple: lost.
In quel momento erano a metà cena → past continuous.

items.prompt: They ___ football when it started to rain.
items.why: L'azione lunga interrotta va al continuous: were playing.

items.prompt: I was walking home when I ___ my teacher.
items.why: L'azione breve che interrompe va al past simple: met.
Dopo did il verbo è base: What did you do yesterday?

items.prompt: He ___ me a message last night.
items.why: Il passato di send è sent. Attenzione: sent non ha niente a che fare con see.
Il passato di see è saw. La terza forma, seen, non si usa da sola.

items.prompt: She ___ at home when I called.
items.why: Non c'è altro verbo → to be al passato: she wasn't at home.
Nessun altro verbo → to be: Were you at the cinema?
C'è il verbo watch → Did you watch the match?

options: I went to the stadium on Sunday.
I studied with Mark on Sunday.
I was going to the stadium on Sunday.
I go to the stadium on Sunday.
items.answer: I went to the stadium on Sunday.
items.why: went è il passato di go, cioè andare. Non confonderlo con altri verbi.

options: I was eating when you arrived.
I was eat when you arrived.
items.answer: I was eating when you arrived.
items.why: "Stavo mangiando" → past continuous; "sei arrivato" → past simple.

items.q: Rendi negativa: He took the train.
items.why: didn't + forma base: take, non took.
